tasks.subject: Task 1: SingleFlight async helper
tasks.description:
**Goal:** Reusable `SingleFlight<T>` in inkapp-core that collapses concurrent async calls into one execution.

**Files:** crates/inkapp-core/src/single_flight.rs (create), crates/inkapp-core/src/lib.rs, crates/inkapp-core/Cargo.toml (futures dep, tokio dev-dep)

**Verify:** nix develop -c cargo test -p inkapp-core single_flight

```json:metadata
{"files": ["crates/inkapp-core/src/single_flight.rs", "crates/inkapp-core/src/lib.rs", "crates/inkapp-core/Cargo.toml"], "verifyCommand": "nix develop -c cargo test -p inkapp-core single_flight", "acceptanceCriteria": ["two concurrent run() calls invoke closure once", "fresh flight after completion", "cargo test passes"]}
```

tasks.subject: Task 2: Connector + ConnectorSet traits, ConnectorError
tasks.description:
**Goal:** Define the framework-facing Connector trait, ConnectorSet enumeration seam, and ConnectorError. No connector implements it yet.

**Files:** crates/inkapp-core/src/connector.rs (create), crates/inkapp-core/src/lib.rs, crates/inkapp/src/lib.rs (facade re-exports), crates/inkapp-core/Cargo.toml (async-trait)

**Verify:** nix develop -c cargo test -p inkapp-core connector

```json:metadata
{"files": ["crates/inkapp-core/src/connector.rs", "crates/inkapp-core/src/lib.rs", "crates/inkapp/src/lib.rs", "crates/inkapp-core/Cargo.toml"], "verifyCommand": "nix develop -c cargo test -p inkapp-core connector", "acceptanceCriteria": ["Connector object-safe", "ConnectorSet returns Vec<Arc<dyn Connector>>", "fake-connector unit test passes"]}
```

tasks.subject: Task 3: Readwise implements Connector (transport, retry, single-flight, cache)
tasks.description:
**Goal:** Migrate Readwise to the Connector trait: RwLock cache via single-flighted refresh, pluggable WriteTransport, deferred-write queue flushed with retry, failed_writes(). App-facing reads stay sync; existing readwise tests stay green.

**Files:** crates/inkapp-readwise/src/lib.rs (rewrite), crates/inkapp-readwise/tests/delivery.rs (create), crates/inkapp-readwise/Cargo.toml (async-trait, inkapp-core; tokio dev-dep)

**Verify:** nix develop -c cargo test -p inkapp-readwise

```json:metadata
{"files": ["crates/inkapp-readwise/src/lib.rs", "crates/inkapp-readwise/tests/delivery.rs", "crates/inkapp-readwise/Cargo.toml"], "verifyCommand": "nix develop -c cargo test -p inkapp-readwise", "acceptanceCriteria": ["Readwise impls Connector", "deferred writes flushed via transport", "retry-then-deliver and permanent-fail->failed_writes", "existing readwise tests green"]}
```

tasks.subject: Task 4: Async loop — render/step async, all call sites migrate
tasks.description:
**Goal:** App::render/step become async (refresh before sync core, flush after), bound Cx: ConnectorSet; migrate all call sites in one green commit: reading-queue Connectors (Arc<Readwise> + ConnectorSet + from_arc), serve/main/device, harness keystone.

**Files:** crates/inkapp-core/src/runtime.rs, apps/reading-queue/src/{lib,serve,main}.rs, apps/reading-queue/tests/device.rs, apps/reading-queue/Cargo.toml (tokio), crates/inkapp-harness/tests/app_loop.rs, crates/inkapp-harness/Cargo.toml (tokio dev-dep)

**Verify:** nix develop -c cargo test --workspace

ATOMIC migration — must stay green in one commit.

```json:metadata
{"files": ["crates/inkapp-core/src/runtime.rs", "apps/reading-queue/src/lib.rs", "apps/reading-queue/src/serve.rs", "apps/reading-queue/src/main.rs", "apps/reading-queue/tests/device.rs", "apps/reading-queue/Cargo.toml", "crates/inkapp-harness/tests/app_loop.rs", "crates/inkapp-harness/Cargo.toml"], "verifyCommand": "nix develop -c cargo test --workspace", "acceptanceCriteria": ["render/step async + ConnectorSet bound", "Connectors as Arc + ConnectorSet impl", "workspace builds, async keystone green"]}
```

tasks.subject: Task 5: App-driven failure banner
tasks.description:
**Goal:** reading-queue view reads failed_writes() and prepends a _banner document when a write permanently failed. Framework stays out of presentation.

**Files:** apps/reading-queue/src/lib.rs (Banner component + banner-aware view), apps/reading-queue/tests/banner.rs (create)

**Verify:** nix develop -c cargo test -p reading-queue

```json:metadata
{"files": ["apps/reading-queue/src/lib.rs", "apps/reading-queue/tests/banner.rs"], "verifyCommand": "nix develop -c cargo test -p reading-queue", "acceptanceCriteria": ["banner doc on failure with 'couldn't sync'", "no banner when no failures", "reading-queue tests green"]}
```
